name: SSRF in XML entity resolution
description: XML resolution can send requests outside intended locations when proxy URL configuration defeats the allowlist.
version_notes: Ranges describe GeoServer releases. Configuration, mitigations, and locally backported patches require separate verification.
prerequisites: ENTITY_RESOLUTION_ALLOWLIST is in use
The configured proxy base URL has neither a path nor a trailing slash
remediation: Upgrade to a patched release; a proxy base URL with a path or trailing slash is the documented workaround.
template_notes: No active template is mapped; a suitable probe must be reviewed before scanning.
